profile.subtitleJa: マリアの子ヨハネで、マルコとも呼ばれた人物。
profile.summaryJa: 使徒言行録12:12で、マリアの子として「マルコと呼ばれるヨハネ」と紹介される。
profile.identityNoteJa: 本文で「マルコと呼ばれるヨハネ」と明示される人物。「ヨハネ」という名だけから洗礼者ヨハネや使徒ヨハネと同一視しない。

facts.textJa: ヨハネ・マルコはバルナバとサウロに同行して旅立った。
宣教旅行で同行したヨハネは、パンフィリアで一行を離れてエルサレムへ戻った。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.
Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.
When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.
Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.
Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.
Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,
